This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Keshiri''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], and was the uncle of controversial [[Geology|geologist]] [[Adari Vaal]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], as mobs descended upon Vaal's home after she was accused of heresy, Vaal sent her [[Eulyn|mother]] and [[Finn Vaal|two]] [[Tona Vaal|sons]] to stay with her uncle.<ref name="Skyborn" />
